document.title: Security audit 2026-11-07 (4): unit tests and logic refactor

acknowledgments.summary: audit of pull request test/unit-tests before merge, directed by the maintainer

notes.title: Summary
notes.text: Audit of the change that moves the timer, layout, clamping and network path logic from src/nixie-countdown.c into src/nixie-logic.c (no OBS dependency), adds unit tests in tests/, the run-tests.sh and run-tests.ps1 scripts, and a Unit Tests workflow that runs them on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows. No security issues found.

notes.title: Audit details
notes.text: Refactor: the moved code is unchanged apart from renamed constants (NIXIE_ prefix) and two behavior differences, both reviewed: (1) Start and Start/Pause now rebuild the layout immediately instead of on the next video tick; (2) nixie_layout_width now sums in int64_t and saturates at UINT32_MAX instead of summing in int, which removes any remaining overflow path even for very large custom tube images. All timer and layout calls still happen with the source mutex held; nixie-logic.c has no global state. The layout buffer bounds checks (append_char, append_num) are unchanged and are now covered by tests with INT64_MAX totals that check the byte after the buffer is untouched. Scripts: run-tests.sh runs with set -euo pipefail and quoted paths; its only deletion is rm -rf of build_tests inside the repository. run-tests.ps1 stops on errors and only removes build_tests under its own folder. Workflow: unit-tests.yaml is called with contents: read, uses actions/checkout pinned to a commit hash, has no secrets, and has no untrusted expressions in run steps (matrix values are static).

notes.title: Test evidence
notes.text: 101 checks in 17 tests pass locally on Debian 13. Mutation check: four deliberate bugs (layout width, blink timing, zero-duration start, network path detection) were each introduced in a copy of nixie-logic.c and each made the tests fail. Tests cover the earlier fixes NIXIE-2026-001 (clamping, saturating width) and NIXIE-2026-002 (network path detection).

notes.title: Result
notes.text: No findings. Logged as required by the project's audit policy.
